Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class ProtectionGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.ProtectionGameTests
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
public final class ProtectionGameTests extends Object implements net.fabricmc.fabric.api.gametest.v1.FabricGameTest
The rules that keep a gesture from writing where it should not: build height, entity obstruction, and waterlogging, plus growth answering to the same checks in both simulation and commit.

    • checkedPlacementPlacesInBoundsAndRejectsOutsideBuildHeight

      public void checkedPlacementPlacesInBoundsAndRejectsOutsideBuildHeight(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal checked-placement test: place stone at an in-bounds position, then try a position one below the minimum build height. Only the in-bounds call succeeds. The out-of-world call has no direct player reproduction.

      Nearest manual check: select Storage and V-place an admissible item against a floor in bounds, then try to grow a stack beyond the world's upper build limit. No out-of-bounds block should appear.

    • checkedPlacementRejectsAnObstructingEntity

      public void checkedPlacementRejectsAnObstructingEntity(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The fixture puts a cow inside the proposed full stone shape and calls checked placement; placement fails.

      Nearest manual check: confine a cow in the destination above a floor, select Storage, and V-right-click the floor holding dirt. The obstructed Storage block must not appear.

    • storageGrowthAnswersToProtectionInSimulationAndCommit

      public void storageGrowthAnswersToProtectionInSimulationAndCommit(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      World-border fixture: fill one Storage block, first confirm a free headroom offer has capacity, then move the border to exclude the target and try simulation and commit. Both refuse the entire four-item offer without growth or input mutation.

      To reproduce, allow height above one, fill a Storage pile, and use /worldborder center and /worldborder set to exclude its prospective growth position. Offer admissible items to first headroom through slot-addressing automation. No upper block appears. Restore the original border after the check; dry-run results require simulation/abort support.

    • storageGrowthRejectsAnObstructingEntityInSimulationAndCommit

      public void storageGrowthRejectsAnObstructingEntityInSimulationAndCommit(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce: allow height above one, fill one Storage block, and confine a cow in the prospective upper block's first occupied position. Offer four admissible items to first headroom through automation. Commit refuses them all and creates no block. The automated check also asserts dry-run refusal and unchanged caller input; simulation/abort needs an automation probe.

    • automatedRemovalUsesNativeActorAndHonorsVeto

      public void automatedRemovalUsesNativeActorAndHonorsVeto(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      To reproduce: deny automated cleanup through a protection mod, then allow it.     • nativeAdjacentDepositConsultsBothPositions

      public void nativeAdjacentDepositConsultsBothPositions(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Native adjacent-deposit fixture: put stone west of an empty Singles block and aim through the stone's east face toward its bottom cell. A Fabric UseBlockCallback veto is applied first at the clicked stone and then at the Singles destination. Either veto prevents deposit; allowing both deposits one stone.

      To check manually, put an existing Singles block east of a stone block and aim through that face while V-depositing stone. Configure protection to deny interaction at the clicked block, then only at the destination, then at neither. Only the last configuration deposits; loader-exact callback vetoes require a test listener if the protection mod lacks separate rules.

    • completedShapesDistinguishOccupiedCellsFromEmptySpace

      public void completedShapesDistinguishOccupiedCellsFromEmptySpace(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Internal obstruction-shape check: a cow overlaps one edge of the target position. Full and occupied-edge shapes are obstructed; empty shapes and distant Singles/Bar positions are clear. No block placement or deposit is performed.

      Nearest manual check: hold a cow at one edge of a destination and attempt first placement of Singles or Bar into occupied-edge and clear positions. Only shapes overlapping the cow should prevent placement.
